text: Refactored EventModelBuilder buildEither off the coarse try/Right(build(...)) wrapper. The builder now resolves schedule, compiles terms, assembles EventModel, and attaches contrasts through explicit Either stages. Added typed DesignError cases for InvalidSubset, InvalidHrfFun, and UnsupportedContrastTarget. Added TypedCoreSuite coverage for negative durations -> InvalidSchedule, invalid subset -> InvalidSubset, bad hrf_fun result -> InvalidHrfFun, unknown HRF basis -> UnknownBasis, and unknown contrast set -> UnknownContrast. Unsupported contrast target is guarded in attachContrastSetsEither; current public formula AST cannot produce a contrast ref for non-convolved terms.
